summary: Two extraction defects can bypass the required guards. Previous findings are addressed by static inspection. All five execution checks remain NOT_RUN as instructed.

checks.criterion: AC1: Shared LaTeX-to-prose extraction with source lines and required exclusions.
checks.evidence: Both consumers import tex_prose, but paper/scripts/tex_prose.py:753 preserves whitespace that TeX ignores after formatting commands, and :654 consumes only one character of an unbraced input filename. See findings.

checks.criterion: AC2: Recursive file coverage, finding format, failure exit and no rule-disabling option.
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/tex_prose.py:307 recursively selects .tex files with only figures/styles.tex excluded. paper/scripts/lint_prose.py:115 formats findings; :246 exposes only --root; :254 prints findings and returns 1.

checks.criterion: AC3: All six prose rules, permitted exceptions and TikZ handling.
checks.evidence: Rules are implemented at paper/scripts/lint_prose.py:56 and :141, but extraction turns seam\emph {less} into separate words and similarly splits impor\emph {tant} inside the forbidden phrase. Mandatory rules b and c can therefore miss rendered prose.

checks.criterion: AC4: Normalized 12-token overlap detection, maximal reporting and reference-record handling.
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/overlap_check.py:36 fixes the threshold at 12; :72 normalizes tokens; :80 finds maximal runs; :138 validates records. However, extraction defects feed incorrect tokens into :118 and can hide a shared 12-word passage.

checks.criterion: AC5: Initialize the reference-verification record with an empty references object.
AC6: Required meaningful tests, test-first failing execution and temporary inputs.
checks.evidence: The test files contain substantive assertions and temporary inputs. git ls-tree at fbf3c38 shows tests present before the three implementation modules. Historical failing execution and current test results were not independently observed; execution is prohibited in this read-only review.

checks.criterion: AC7: Build targets and ordering, passing manuscript and README commands.
checks.evidence: paper/Makefile:5 serializes execution; :25 orders numbers, lint, overlap, test and pdf; :43 and :47 invoke the scripts. paper/README.md:22 documents both commands. Manuscript passes and successful command execution cannot be established without running checks.

checks.criterion: Previous fix codex-r1-1: comments before command arguments.
checks.evidence: Static inspection: paper/scripts/tex_prose.py:558 skips and records comments while locating arguments; :644 uses that scanner. Regression assertions cover extraction at test_tex_prose.py:145, lint at test_lint_prose.py:419 and overlap at test_overlap_check.py:123.

checks.criterion: Previous fix codex-r1-2: retained TikZ command arguments.
checks.evidence: Static inspection: paper/scripts/tex_prose.py:483 retains the TikZ region and blanks only comments. paper/scripts/lint_prose.py:216 uses that extraction for word rules. test_lint_prose.py:374 covers the previously discarded tikzset label.

checks.criterion: Previous fix codex-r2-1: ordinary adjacent groups.
checks.evidence: Static inspection: paper/scripts/tex_prose.py:281 limits known command arity; :576 marks argument boundaries instead of every adjacent group. Existing reported examples have regressions at test_tex_prose.py:308, test_lint_prose.py:122 and test_overlap_check.py:129.

checks.criterion: Previous rebuttal claude-r1-1: Ralph bookkeeping outside story paths.
checks.evidence: scripts/ralph/prompt.md:21 expressly permits the batch story list and progress log. Reading the changed-path lists of the 15 specified implementation commits shows only the nine scoped paper paths; no config/run.yaml or scientific artifacts changed.

checks.criterion: Previous rebuttal claude-r1-2: matching bare bold declarations.
checks.evidence: paper/scripts/lint_prose.py:104 bounds the command names; :205 exempts tabular spans. Matching bare \bf is consistent with prohibiting bold prose. test_lint_prose.py:325 covers declarations and :349 excludes the longer command name.

findings.claim: Ignored whitespace after formatting commands becomes a word boundary, allowing both prose and overlap guards to be bypassed.
findings.evidence: Static trace, not executed: _prose_command returns immediately after the control word, leaving its following whitespace for _prose to copy. Thus seam\emph {less} renders seamless but extracts as seam less, escaping banned_word_hits. Against the existing test abstract, 'We measure the roughness of lu\emph {nar} and martian terrain at baselines from' similarly splits lunar and hides the shared 12-word run. Consume nonprinting control-word whitespace while preserving source locations, and add regressions for both consumers.

findings.claim: Unbraced input filenames are only partially removed, violating the required exclusion and contaminating overlap tokens.
findings.evidence: Static trace, not executed: \input is routed through the generic mandatory-argument scanner. For the valid form '\input generated/numbers.tex', the fallback at line 654 consumes only 'g', leaving 'enerated/numbers.tex' as prose. Inserted between words six and seven of a shared passage, those filename tokens interrupt the 12-word match. Handle input's complete filename syntax and add extraction and consumer regressions; existing tests cover only braced input.
